θ.tip: You said /s/. Put your tongue lightly between your teeth and blow — /θ/ has no hiss.
You said /t/. Keep the tongue forward between the teeth instead of tapping the ridge.
You said /f/. Use the tongue tip (not the lip) against the teeth for /θ/.

ð.tip: You said /d/. /ð/ is voiced with the tongue tip gently between the teeth — no plosion.
You said /z/. Move the tongue forward to the teeth for voiced /ð/.

w.tip: You said /v/. Round both lips for /w/ — no teeth touching lip.

v.tip: You said /w/. Touch the top teeth to the bottom lip and buzz for /v/.

r.tip: You said /l/. Curl the tongue back without touching the roof for English /r/.

l.tip: You said /r/. Let the tongue tip touch the ridge for /l/.

iː.tip: You said /ɪ/. Lengthen and tense your lips for /iː/ (sheep, not ship).

ɪ.tip: You said /iː/. Relax and shorten it — /ɪ/ (ship, not sheep).

æ.tip: You said /e/. Open the jaw wider for /æ/ (bad, not bed).
You said /ɑː/. Lift the tongue and flatten it a little for /æ/.

ʃ.tip: You said /s/. Pull the tongue back slightly and round the lips for /ʃ/.

ʒ.tip: You said /dʒ/. Remove the plosion — /ʒ/ is a continuous buzz.

ŋ.tip: You said /n/. Raise the back of the tongue against the soft palate for /ŋ/.

h.tip: You made a harsh scrape. English /h/ is a soft breath.

eɪ.tip: You dropped the glide. Finish the diphthong with an /ɪ/ movement.

əʊ.tip: You said a pure vowel. Round into a /ʊ/ off-glide for /əʊ/.
